skill.dragonminez.racial_humanrevamp.ki_: Your Ki regenerates %1$s%% faster. Your power bonus scales with your current Ki, reaching %2$s%% at %3$s%% Ki and fading to zero at %4$s%% Ki.
skill.dragonminez.racial_humanrevamp.and: Androids only (upgraded by Dr. Gero). Your bonus Ki regeneration is increased by %1$s%% and your hunger no longer decreases, but your Ki-based power boost is reduced by %2$s%%.
skill.dragonminez.racial_saiyanrevamp.ze: Surviving and fully recovering from a near-death experience grants a permanent stat boost based on the HP you lost, with diminishing returns after repeated uses. Cooldown: %1$s seconds.
skill.dragonminez.racial_saiyanrevamp.li: Each Zenkai you receive increases the amount of power you can release, up to +%1$s%% when you reach the maximum number of Zenkais.
skill.dragonminez.racial_frostdemonrevam: Your Speed and Ki Power increase as your HP decreases. Your attacks cost %1$s%% less Stamina.
skill.dragonminez.racial_bioandroidrevam: You gain %1$s%% of Frost Demon, Saiyan, Namekian and Human skills, and your own skill changes with your form: Vital Drain in the Imperfect form, Vital Drain or Self-Destruct in the Semi-Perfect form, and Summon Cell Jr. in the Perfect form.
skill.dragonminez.racial_majinrevamp.abs: Select the racial skill in the X menu and hold G for %1$s seconds while aiming at a weaker player or mob within 3 blocks. The target is absorbed: you heal %2$s%% of your max health and permanently gain %3$s%% of its configured stats before decay. Up to five absorbed mobs can be ejected; older bonuses become permanent.
Select the racial skill in the X menu and hold G for %1$s seconds while aiming at a weaker Namekian within 3 blocks. The target is assimilated: you heal %2$s%% of your max health and permanently gain %3$s%% of your configured stats before decay. Cooldown: %4$s seconds.
race.dragonminez.android.desc: Artificial life forms, made entirely by metal or being half humans, they are augmented versions of humans far stronger than them, but incapable of using Ki, and therefore incapable of gaining legendary or god ki.
gui.dragonminez.character_stats.skp.desc: Increases your Movement and Attack Speed while also lowering dash and attacks cooldown.
gui.dragonminez.character_stats.spd.desc: §7Increases your Movement and Attack Speed while also lowering dash and attacks cooldown.
gui.dragonminez.character_stats.res.desc: Increases your maximum Stamina and reduces the damage you take from enemies
message.dmzrevamp.zenkai.wounded: Your body is heavily wounded, but surviving this may make you stronger...
message.dmzrevamp.zenkai.near_death: Death almost claimed you, yet you survived. You may become even more powerful if you recover.
message.dmzrevamp.zenkai.friendly_fist: You were never in real danger. You will become more powerful, but not by as much.
message.dmzrevamp.zenkai.recovered: You have fully recovered and feel more powerful than before!
gui.dragonminez.character_stats.strike_d: The Speed value used for movement and attack speed
Upgrading Speed increases this value by %1$s points.
skill.dragonminez.racial_humanrevamp.des: Your Ki regenerates %1$s%% faster, and its power bonus scales with your current Ki, reaching %2$s%% at 90%% Ki. At low HP, your Adrenaline kicks in and grants you a boost in power. §6Android Upgraded§r: Your Ki regeneration doubles and your hunger no longer decreases, but the Ki-based power boost is halved. You also lose Adrenaline, but gain a barrier that protects you from attacks.
skill.dragonminez.racial_saiyanrevamp.de: Surviving and fully recovering from a near-death experience grants a permanent stat boost based on the HP you lost, with diminishing returns after repeated uses. This has a cooldown of %1$s seconds. After each Zenkai, you can push your power even further beyond, and Rage can boost your power even more.
skill.dragonminez.racial_frostrevamp.des: Your Speed and Ki Power increase as your HP decreases. Your attacks cost %1$s%% less Stamina. In lower forms, you can accumulate power and expend it in higher forms for a major power boost.
skill.dragonminez.racial_frostdemonrevam: Your Speed and Ki Power increase as your HP decreases. Your attacks cost %1$s%% less Stamina. In lower forms, you can accumulate power and expend it in higher forms for a major power boost.
skill.dragonminez.racial_bioandroidrevam: You have access to %1$s%% of the Humans', Saiyans', Namekians' and Frost Demons' racial abilities. On top of that, you have unique abilities depending on your form: Life Drain, self-destruction, or creating junior versions of yourself.
skill.dragonminez.racial_majinrevamp.des: Majins can absorb other entities, restoring %1$s%% of their maximum health and permanently gaining %2$s%% of the target's configured stats. You recover more from food, and your healing techniques are stronger, cheaper, and recharge faster.
class.dragonminez.paladin.passive.desc: 15% of the damage your party members take is redirected to you. You heal for 15% of the damage your party members deal.
class.dragonminez.warrior.passive.desc: Each Melee hit grants you a Fury Stack if not blocked, and they stack up to 10. Each stack increases STM regen by 5% and Defense Penetration by 1%. Stacks refresh when you deal damage and fade if you stop.
class.dragonminez.berserker.passive.desc: For each 1% HP you lose, you gain +0.5% Crit Chance and +1% Crit Damage
class.dragonminez.spiritualist.passive.d: Damage Ki attacks have 20% reduced cooldown and cost. If the attack has an effect, cooldown is reduced by 15% instead, but effects last 25% longer.
class.dragonminez.cleric.passive.desc: Healing Ki attacks have 20% reduced cooldown and cost. If the attack has an effect, cooldown is reduced by 15% instead, but effects last 25% longer.
Melee, Strike and Ki Attacks deal 25% more damage against enemies below 50% HP.
class.dragonminez.speedster.passive.desc: Each Melee hit grants you a Momentum Stack if not blocked, and they stack up to 10. Each stack increases SPD by 1% and you gain Additional damage equal to 5% of your SPD. Stacks refresh when you deal damage and fade if you stop.
class.dragonminez.duelist.passive.desc: Parrying Melee attacks deals 10% more poise damage on the enemy and Parrying a Ki Blast makes it go to the way you are looking with 20% more speed and can harm the caster. Attacking someone with Guard Broken deals 50% more damage and 100% more knockback
class.dragonminez.kiassassin.passive.des: Ki attacks without effects have 50% reduced cast time and 50% more speed. Ki attacks with effects have 20% reduced cast time and 20% more speed.
Assimilate weaker Namekians to heal %1$s%% of your maximum HP and permanently gain %2$s%% of the configured stats before decay. You can exchange Stamina and Ki to recover HP, or submerge yourself in water to regenerate faster.
